card.name: Words before a state or province
card.fires_on: Quantifiers and linking words (every, all, any, 'and', commas) placed just before an expected regional unit such as state, Land, province or county. Also appears in lists of administrative levels like national, state and district.

modes.label: Capital and region links
modes.description: Words leading into a named province or commonwealth.
modes.example: Richmond is the capital of<< the>> Commonwealth of Virginia, in the United States

card.writes: It raises province and region words and lowers country words, pointing the next word toward a sub-national unit.
card.plain: It fires on small words that signal the next word will be a state or province, not a country.
